metadata.title: Shannon Shakes Hands with Chernoff: Big Data Viewpoint On Channel Information Measures

extraction_notes.note: The main findings are read off ACE-transform plots (figures); stated as claims with rigor numerical.
The ACE pseudocode prints the 'Iterate until' line twice (outer and inner loop) and closes loops with plain STATE lines; the two End-loop lines were dropped and the steps left flat as returned.
corollary or claim: the paper itself calls this inference 'this corollary', so corollary was kept.
Descriptions of the simulated data sets (20000/60000 observations) and the km/cm analogy were left as discussion, not nodes.

nodes.statement: According to [], the Shannon mutual information is defined as: & I_S(X,Y) = D(p(x,y)||p(x)p(y)) cr & = sumlimits_x,y p(x,y)logp(x,y) over p(x)p(y) cr where X,Y are two random variables with marginal probability mass functions p(x) and p(y) and joint probability mass function p(x,y). It is noted that I(X;Y) is the relative entropy (or Kullback-leibler distance) between the joint distribution p(x,y) and the product distribution p(x)p(y).
